canonical_title: Meta releases Muse Glimmer open-weight local agent model
treatment: Repeat only for official model card, weights/license details, reproducible independent benchmarks, material hardware requirements, or actual Muse Spark 1.2 weight release.
known_facts: Meta released Muse Glimmer as a smaller open-weight model intended to run agentic tasks locally on a Mac or PC with a single graphics card.
Meta also said it plans to release the weights of Muse Spark 1.2, but that release had not occurred at this run time.
The announcement was paired with Mark Zuckerberg's renewed policy push for open-weight AI.
